The same Form 10-K describes U.S. Bank Subsidiaries customers as including high to ultra-high net worth individuals, and separately references ultra-high net worth clients as the target of tailored lending in the Wealth Management business segment.

Merrill: In its November 5, 2025 investor-day deck, Merrill's Wealth Continuum uses the labels "Mass Affluent" and "High Net Worth" for client tiers. The first-quarter 2026 deck (period ended March 31, 2026) uses the label "Merrill primary households" for households with $250K+ in investable assets within the enterprise, excluding Stock Plan and Banking-only households, and the label "Private Bank core relationships" for relationships with $3MM+ in total balances. The 2025 Form 10-K (period ended December 31, 2025) uses the labels "high net worth and ultra high net worth clients" for the Private Bank and Merrill Private Wealth Management business.

Merrill: The 2025 Form 10-K (period ended December 31, 2025) states that Merrill Wealth Management's advisory business is focused on clients with over $250,000 in total investable assets. The November 5, 2025 investor-day deck defines the Wealth Continuum's Mass Affluent tier as $500K - $1MM and its High Net Worth tier as $1MM - $10MM, and reports 54K $10MM+ households, indicating a $10MM+ household segment. The first-quarter 2026 deck (period ended March 31, 2026) defines Merrill primary households as those with $250K+ in investable assets within the enterprise, excluding stock plan and banking-only households, and defines Bank of America Private Bank core relationships as those with $3MM+ in total balances. On the third-quarter 2026 earnings call (period ended September 30, 2026), management said Merrill added about 4,200 net new households with at least $500,000 in assets and the Private Bank added 470 net new relationships with at least $3 million under management.

Morgan Stanley: The 2025 Form 10-K (period ended December 31, 2025) states that lending activity in the U.S. Bank Subsidiaries from the Wealth Management business segment primarily includes securities-based lending, other forms of secured loans including tailored lending to ultra-high net worth clients, and residential real estate loans. On the third-quarter 2026 earnings call (period ended September 30, 2026), the CEO said Morgan Stanley clients, importantly including ultra-high net worth clients, have access to private markets via equities, co-investment opportunities, and family office infrastructure solutions. The second-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q (period ended June 30, 2026) states that Wealth Management commercial real estate loans are originated through the private banking platform and generally benefit from full or partial guarantees from high or ultra-high net worth clients.

Merrill: The 2025 Form 10-K (period ended December 31, 2025) states that Merrill Wealth Management's advisory business provides a high-touch client experience through a network of financial advisors, and provides tailored solutions through a full set of investment management, brokerage, banking and retirement products. It also states that for high net worth and ultra high net worth clients, Bank of America Private Bank and Merrill Private Wealth Management provide comprehensive wealth management and customized solutions for wealth structuring, investment management, trust and banking needs, including specialty asset management services. An undated Merrill web page (page content as of November 3, 2026) states Merrill provides robust solutions for ultra-high-net-worth clients, including alternative investments and sustainable and impact investing strategies.

Morgan Stanley and Merrill: The comparison of client segmentation approaches by wealth tier is valid only at the level of stated approach and labels, not at the level of wealth thresholds. Morgan Stanley's 2025 Form 10-K describes Wealth Management as serving individual investors including high and ultra-high net worth individuals and segments clients through three channels (Advisor-Led, Self-Directed, Workplace), without stating wealth thresholds in the documents searched. Merrill's 2025 Form 10-K and investor-day/deck materials segment clients through a "wealth continuum" with dollar-denominated tiers and qualifying segments—Mass Affluent ($500K - $1MM), High Net Worth ($1MM - $10MM), Merrill primary households ($250K+ investable assets within the enterprise), and Private Bank core relationships ($3MM+ total balances). The threshold-level comparison is not valid because Morgan Stanley states no comparable wealth thresholds, and Merrill's thresholds use different units and scopes.
